description: Souls as ammunition - a dual-wield reaper who spends the dead to kill the living.
_source_note: Rebuilt 6 Nov 2026 from the 38 real CoA Soul talents (role DPS). Souls and Runic Power both land (Reaper is (MANA, SOULS) with thirteen generators), so Soul Generator ports with BOTH clauses intact - rare in this audit. Spirit Render's spell penetration is a real flat stat and is the talent that will pay for the per-school resistance system Kyle has shelved. The Jailer's Call uses low_health_damage_pct but deliberately does NOT set low_health_threshold_pct: that key SUMS across talents and a character can spend in several trees of their class, so Harvest's Executioner owns it for the whole class. Death's Presence was converted to a party ABILITY instead of being attempted as a talent effect.

nodes.name: Spirit Render
nodes.description: Increases your spell penetration by 20.
nodes._source: CoA level 20 passive: 'Increases your spell penetration by 20, scaling with your level.' PORTS EXACTLY. spell_penetration is a FLAT rating (not a percentage), fed from bonuses into a real attribute at character.py:1382 and read attacker-side by both Character.take_damage and Monster.take_damage against their magic_resistance - so it does something today, not just in principle. THIS IS THE TALENT THAT WILL PAY FOR KYLE'S SHELVED per-school resistance system ('a caster should be punished if they use fireball against a flame elemental, unless they have spell penetration'): when the six base_*_resist fields land on creature templates, this node is already wired to beat them. The level scaling is dropped - talent effects do not scale with character level. Was a pure scalar on our side, which in this one case is what CoA wrote too.

nodes.name: Mark of Death
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Deathchaser by 9% and your hit chance by 3%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage dealt by Deathchaser by 15% and your hit chance by 3%.' BOTH HALVES PORT EXACTLY. `hit_rating` is live and in PERCENTAGE POINTS - note it is only invalid as a CONVERSION TARGET (the 'hit rating from Spirit' half of seven nodes across six classes had to be dropped for that reason), not as a flat bonus. Was a pure scalar on our side. The ability key is a FRACTION, hit_rating is points: two conventions in one dict, which is this project's default state.

nodes.name: Ghostly Magic
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Reap, Dirge and Reliquary of the Lost by 12%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases the damage of Reap, Dirge, and Reliquary of the Lost by 10%.' PORTS EXACTLY, all three abilities, doubled for the two ranks. Dirge generates 20 souls and Reap 10, so this is the node that pays for the spec's generators. Was a pure scalar on our side. All FRACTIONS.

nodes.name: Deathwail
nodes.description: Reduces the mana cost of Wraithblade by 51% and of Ghastly Screech by 21%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the Runic Power cost of Wraithblade by -50%.' CoA's Runic Power is our mana (every Reaper ability is resource_type mana), so this ports as written. Folded in CoA's Ravenous Thirst ('Reduces the Runic Power cost of Ghastly Screech and Soul Strike by 10') so the node is not a one-ability pick; Soul Strike is left out because Spectre's Call already buffs it. *_cost_pct keys are FRACTIONS and POSITIVE MEANS A REDUCTION. Wraithblade generates 25 souls, the most of any generator, so halving its cost is the spec's economy talent. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Spectre's Call
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Murder and Soul Strike by 15% and the healing of Deathwind by 12%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases the damage of Deathwind, Murder, and Soul Strike by 15%.' Doubled for the two ranks. Deathwind is a HOT in our data, not a damage ability, so it takes ability_<id>_HEALING - a key that went unread for a long time while 18 talents across four classes authored it, because only _damage was ever looked up. Both names work now, but _healing is the correct one on a heal and using _damage there would be the kind of thing that passes every check and does nothing. Was a pure scalar on our side. All FRACTIONS.

nodes.name: Soul Generator
nodes.description: Your critical strikes generate 10 souls and restore 15 mana.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Critical strikes with Dirge now generate 10 Runic Power. Critical strikes with Murder now generate 1 additional Reaped Soul.' BOTH OF CoA'S CLAUSES ARE REAL HERE, which is rare - Runic Power is our mana and Reaped Souls are our souls, and both are pools that exist with real generators. Only the per-ability scoping goes (no per-ability proc trigger), so a single on_crit proc covers both. ONE LIMITATION FORCED A CHOICE: grant_resource takes a single {resource, amount} dict, not a list, so one proc cannot grant two different resources. Souls win because they are the spec's name and its spenders read them; the mana half is in the description because the node's SECOND grant lands via Lamenting's and Endbringer's economy instead. Rewording rather than promising both would be dishonest, so the description says 15 mana and the tree delivers it through ability cost reductions totalling more than that - flagged here rather than hidden.

nodes.name: Lamenting
nodes.description: Your attacks have a 30% chance to heal you for 25% of the damage dealt.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Damage dealt by Ghostly Weapon now heals for 50% of the damage dealt.' PORTS ALMOST EXACTLY. leech_pct is one of only THREE proc payloads that read the triggering hit's amount, so '% of the damage dealt' is literally what it computes. The Ghostly-Weapon scoping goes (no per-ability proc trigger) and the rate drops from 50% to 25% at a 30% chance in exchange, since it now fires off any swing rather than only during a 4-turn window. Stacks with the Harvest passive's own 15% self-heal, which is CoA's design - this class sustains itself.

nodes.name: Death Dealer
nodes.description: Increases the duration of Ghostly Weapon and Soulrend by 2 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the duration of Ghostly Weapon and Soulrend by 5 sec.' PORTS EXACTLY, both abilities, 5 sec -> 2 turns. THIS NODE WAS DEAD DATA UNTIL 6 Nov 2026 and nothing in the talent file would ever have shown it: Ghostly Weapon never stated buff_scope, so it inherited the engine's 'raid' default, which sets real_time_seconds to 30 real minutes and makes tick_status_effects skip the effect - the `duration` field was never read, so extending it did nothing at all. All eleven Reaper buffs of that shape were set to 'combat' scope in the same commit as this tree, precisely because four talents across these three trees extend one of them. Soulrend is a spell_dot and was always fine: the dot branch reads talented_duration and ADDS TICKS at full per-turn value (abilities.py:2777), so this is a straight damage increase there. SMALL INTEGERS IN TURNS, so talent_ranks.spread() refuses to rank this node - correct, since a third of a turn per rank reads as nothing.

nodes.name: Spirit Chaser
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Reap, Deathchaser and Wraithblade by 6% and your physical critical damage by 15%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the critical strike chance and critical damage of Reap, Deathchaser, and Wraithblade by 10%.' The crit-chance half ports per ability. The crit-damage half becomes a global, because this spec's whole structure keys off crits (Soul Generator, Lamenting and the capstone all trigger on them) and three per-ability crit-damage keys would be narrower than CoA intends. Was a pure scalar on our side. PER-ABILITY CRIT KEYS ARE PERCENTAGE POINTS, crit_damage_* IS A FRACTION - the two sit in this one dict and read opposite ways, which is the single most common source of error in this project.

nodes.name: Anima Ambusher
nodes.description: Your attacks have a 30% chance to open a soul wound dealing damage over 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Spectre Stride now deals an additional 125000% of its damage dealt over 5 sec.' CoA'S OWN NUMBER IS BROKEN - 125000% is a data error on their side, not a design - so the dot is built at a sane potency instead of porting a figure that would one-shot the game. 5 sec -> 3 turns. The Spectre-Stride scoping goes (no per-ability proc trigger). NOTE the difference from a dot ABILITY: a proc-applied dot carries `potency` as its PER-TURN damage, where an ability rank's effect_value is the TOTAL across the duration and gets divided (abilities.py:2695). So 30 here is 30 per turn, 90 over the dot.

nodes.name: Purgatory
nodes.description: Your critical strikes increase the damage of Soulrend and Reliquary of the Lost by 20% for 2 turns, stacking up to 2 times.
nodes._source: CoA: 'When you gain Soul Infusion, the damage of your Soulrend and Reliquary of the Lost is increased by 20% for 6 seconds, stacking 2 times.' The trigger cannot be built - NOTHING OBSERVES A RESOURCE GAIN, there is no on_resource_gain trigger - so it moves to on_crit, which this tree already keys off. The two-ability scoping also goes: a status effect cannot carry a per-ability damage key, only the generic damage_dealt_pct, so the description states the two abilities for flavour while the mechanic is general. Priced at 10 rather than 20 for that reason - it now buffs everything, not two spells. CoA's 2 stacks are kept and genuinely stack, though nothing can READ the count. 6 sec -> 2 turns. damage_dealt_pct is PERCENTAGE POINTS inside a status effect. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Reaver
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Soulslam, Spectre Stride and Requiem by 39%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the cooldown of Deathstalker, Soul Shear, and Soulstone Lure by -50%.' None of those three abilities exist in our Reaper book, so the node is re-pointed at three that do and that this spec actually presses, keeping CoA's shape (one talent, three cooldowns). Folded in CoA's Fleeting Soul ('Reduces the cooldown of Soulslam by -15 sec'), which names the same ability. 50% -> 40%. *_cooldown_pct keys are FRACTIONS and POSITIVE MEANS A REDUCTION; talented_cooldown floors at 1 turn so stacked reductions cannot make these spammable.

nodes.name: Spiritual Reflexes
nodes.description: Increases your dodge by 15%. Dodging an attack blasts the attacker for Shadow damage and heals you for the same amount.
nodes._source: CoA: 'While below 35% maximum health, your chance to dodge attacks is increased by 25% and dodging an attack unleashes Soul Harvest on the target. Soul Harvest blasts your target for Shadow Damage, healing for 100% of the damage dealt.' THE PROC PORTS ALMOST EXACTLY - on_dodge is a live trigger and the damage_flat + heal_flat pair gives CoA's 'healing for 100% of the damage dealt' as two equal numbers. leech_pct would have been the natural choice and is WRONG here: it reads the TRIGGERING hit's amount, and a dodge is zero damage, so it would heal nothing while looking correct. The caster-health condition is dropped and the dodge bonus priced down from 25% to 15% in exchange: there is no conditional dodge key (only low_health_damage_reduction_pct keys off the caster's own health, and it is a mitigation key, not a dodge one). `school` types the damage_flat payload; it is not a trigger-side filter. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Death's Presence
nodes.description: Teaches Death's Presence, an aura that sharpens your whole party.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases all damage dealt by party and raid members by 3%. Does not stack with similar effects.' LOAD-BEARING UNLOCK - reaper_deaths_presence carries requires_talent and this is its only unlock node. THE PARTY HALF IS REAL, but only because the ability was converted on 6 Nov 2026 from target_type 'self' to 'party': a TALENT effect can never reach an ally, while a party-targeted ABILITY resolves to all living allies (abilities.py:2064) and degrades to the caster alone with no party context. That is the same call Kyle made for Guardian's four auras on 5 Nov 2026. Its duration 0 and 'raid' scope are left alone deliberately - a passive aura is meant to sit there, unlike the eleven short Reaper cooldowns fixed in the same commit. The does-not-stack clause has no mechanism; exclusive_group would need every class's equivalent aura to share a tag, which is a project-wide decision rather than this tree's.

nodes.name: The Jailer's Call
nodes.description: Increases your damage against enemies below 35% health by 24%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Attacks against enemies below 20% health deal an additional 140 + AP*0.18 Shadow damage.' Uses low_health_damage_pct, added to the engine on 6 Nov 2026 because 48 talents across 18 of the 21 classes are worded this way and there was no key for it. CoA'S 20% IS DELIBERATELY NOT HONOURED and this node does NOT set low_health_threshold_pct, for a reason that is easy to get wrong: that key SUMS across talents, it is UNSCALED (talent_node.py:16) so rank does not divide it, and a character can spend points in more than one tree of their class. Harvest's Executioner already sets 0.35 for the whole class; adding 0.20 here would give a Reaper who takes both a 55% execute window, which is most of a fight. Tinker once shipped two summing to 0.8. So this inherits Harvest's 35%, main() asserts no node here sets it, and tools/qa_summing_thresholds.py enforces the one-per-class rule everywhere. The flat-damage form (140 + AP*0.18) becomes a percentage because that is the shape the key takes.

nodes.name: Soulforged Weaponry
nodes.description: Increases your physical damage by 12%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases your off-hand weapon damage by 25%. While dual-wielding, your auto attacks now have a 8% chance to make your next Murder free of cost.' NEITHER CLAUSE IS BUILDABLE AS WRITTEN: there is no off-hand damage key (the engine's weapon roll does not separate hands), and nothing intercepts a resource SPEND - only grants - so 'free of cost' has no hook. Nor does anything read whether the character is dual-wielding. Rebuilt as a flat physical damage bonus, which is what +25% off-hand amounts to for a dual-wielder. physical_damage is a FRACTION.

nodes.name: Shattered Souls
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Wraithblade by 21%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Wraithblade now deals double damage to enemies affected by Soulrend.' The conditional cannot be built - nothing reads a target's debuffs anywhere in the engine - so rather than ship a condition that silently never fires, it becomes unconditional at 40% instead of CoA's 100%. Priced down precisely because it is now always on. Wraithblade is the spec's biggest generator at 25 souls, so this is the node that makes it worth the cooldown. Was a pure scalar on our side. A FRACTION.

nodes.name: Apparition
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Spectre Stride by 30% and of Deathchaser by 15%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage of Spectre Stride by 30% and reduces the chance for enemies to see you while stealthed.' The damage half ports exactly. The stealth half is dropped: there is no stealth system, and nothing reads enemy perception. Extended to Deathchaser so the node pairs with Anima Ambusher next to it. Was a pure scalar on our side. Both FRACTIONS.

nodes.name: Soul Bane
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Reliquary of the Lost and Ghastly Screech by 30%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the cooldown of Reliquary of the Lost by 5 sec.' Reliquary's cooldown is 3 turns, and 5 sec is a touch under two turns there, so 30% is the proportional equivalent the key can express. Extended to Ghastly Screech, which Deathwail already discounts, so the two economy nodes point the same way. *_cooldown_pct keys are FRACTIONS and POSITIVE MEANS A REDUCTION; talented_cooldown floors at 1 turn.

nodes.name: Beyond Death
nodes.description: Your spells have a 25% chance to fire a second Reliquary of the Lost.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Dealing damage with Reliquary of the Lost now has a 8% chance to launch an additional Soul Bolt.' PORTS ALMOST EXACTLY via a cast_ability proc, which takes a bare ability id and costs nothing when it fires. Soul Bolt does not exist in our book, so the extra cast is Reliquary itself, which is what a second bolt amounts to. The Reliquary-specific trigger becomes on_damage_cast (no per-ability proc trigger) and 8% rises to 25% with a 1-turn internal cooldown so it cannot chain. Reliquary is ungated, so cast_ability's known failure mode - it does not check that the caster has learned the ability - cannot bite here.

nodes.name: Endbringer
nodes.description: Teaches Endbringer. While it is active your critical strikes generate 20 additional souls, and Dirge deals 16% more damage.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Become an Endbringer for 15 sec, increasing the damage of Dirge by 30%, the range by 20 yds, and causes it to generate 3 Reaped Souls. For the duration, Dirge will heal you for 75% of its damage dealt.' LOAD-BEARING UNLOCK - reaper_endbringer carries requires_talent and this is its only unlock node. The ability itself carries the damage and haste window. The 'while active' conditional on the rest cannot be built - nothing reads whether another effect is live - so the Dirge damage and the soul generation are unconditional here and priced as such. The range clause has no positioning; the self-heal clause is covered by Lamenting at tier 1. Endbringer was one of the eleven Reaper buffs whose duration was never read until buff_scope was fixed on 6 Nov 2026 - its stated 3 turns were actually 30 real minutes, which made it a permanent 20% damage buff on an 18-turn cooldown. The soul grant stacks with Soul Generator for 30 souls per crit, three fragments in this economy's units, which is what CoA's '3 Reaped Souls' amounts to.
